problem_reproduced.root_cause: calc_linhai_shanten enumerated 24^white_count wildcard replacements; each extra white multiplied runtime by ~8x

fixes: calc_linhai_shanten caps white enumeration at 2, uses shanten-decrement upper bound for >=3 whites (admissible)
shanten_cache_ in LinhaiSearchEngineV3 now persists across searches (tehai->shanten is stateless), capped at 200k entries
v3_service.py honours LINHAI_V3_PROFILE={fast,prod,deep} and legacy LINHAI_V3_FAST; default is prod
conclusion: V3 prod profile delivers 68.2% win rate at 13.6% houjuu rate in 111 seconds for 500 games. Fast profile retains 67.0% at ~65% of the runtime. Deep profile matches prod at this data size; a bigger uplift is expected once A-2b (LightGBM) is in.
